gaps.explanation: detail[] holds the A-1 budgetary-basis schedule (p8; actuals cover all governmental funds), Total Revenues 6,644,739, which lists Interest/dividends 51,083 among revenues. The governmental funds statement (p4) prints Interest/Dividends 51,083 under Other Financing Sources, below Total revenues 6,593,656 (JSON other_financing 51,083). 6,644,739 - 51,083 = 6,593,656. Every other A-1 revenue line equals the p4 Total column (taxes 3,546,267; intergovernmental 1,925,458 + 432,723 = 2,358,181; etc.). A classification difference between two printed totals; no detail line is missing or duplicated.
